errors.text_span: Die y-Achse, die den Fiskalregel-Index des IWF darstellt, reicht von 0 bis 120
errors.evidence: Y-axis for IWF Fiskalindex actually ranges from -5 to 2, not from 0 to 120.
Description claims a maximum of 2.2, but the figure shows a maximum of approximately 2.
Description states approximately 1.3 in 2020, but figure shows around 0.5.
The description fails to mention that the right y-axis represents the Schuldenquote, which ranges from 30 to 70.
The description does not clarify that the right graph focuses on the Schuldenquote des Zentralstaates.

errors.evidence: The color for the Schuldenquote des Gesamtstaates is actually red, not lilac.
